The execution failed the legacy test suite (reward 0.0) specifically in `test_word_summary_content`. The error message indicates: `AssertionError: Word summary must mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations` (assert 0 >= 2). 

This means the `/root/Cycle_Count_Variance_Brief.docx` failed to include the specific Facility-Session IDs identified in the Summary sheet as having the most errors. Although the instructions in Step 7 requested mentioning at least two specific combinations, the generated document text did not match the expected strings (e.g., 'FAC-SESS' or 'FAC SESS'). Review the logic used to pick and format the top 2 `(Facility, Session ID)` combinations in the Word document.
